notes.note: Every non-zero funnel state is unasserted: the progress route is only ever read on a campaign with no assignment, so assigned/attempted/reached/confirmed/neverAttempted are all 0 and the assignment-grain-vs-log-grain split and the queued-disposition exclusion are invisible here. dialer_assignments.campaign_id is ON DELETE RESTRICT, so this sweep cannot own the rows its cleanup needs. The UI layer's campaign-overview spec must own that fixture and assert the five definitions against real call logs.

A Preacher's scope is pinned only by the payload's programScope:false, not by the counts: an empty campaign reads zeros for Admin and Preacher alike, so a route that dropped the scope argument would still pass every row. Proving the predicate excluded another preacher's contacts needs assignments whose contacts carry different assigned_preacher_id values, which belongs to the UI layer's campaign-overview fixture.

The state-bearing refusals are unasserted at HTTP level: 403 campaign_scope_missing needs a seeded Assistant with a null assigned_preacher_id (a fixture mutation this sweep may not make) and 500 campaign_progress_read_failed needs an unreadable payload or an unrecognised SQLSTATE (a database fault it cannot inject). The route forwards getStaffContext() and returns the service error unchanged; the 500 parse arm is the UI layer's or a later integration point's to prove.
